name: Forging the Shaft
summary: After The Flawless Flame, Kalaran Windblade needs a shaft to hold its fire. Eight thorium plated daggers from the cauldron can be reforged into one.

sections.title: Enchanted Alloy
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade needs a shaft and a casing to hold the flawless flame. In the cauldron, Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters wield enchanted thorium, a sturdy metal. Kalaran can break down eight of their daggers and reforge the alloy into a shaft.

sections.title: A Sharp Tongue
sections.body: When you bring the daggers, Kalaran offers jeering instead of thanks. He calls you an exceptional laborer, then asks if you have considered another vocation. Perhaps detective, junk collector, or one of those silly gnomes who comb Azeroth’s beaches with metal-detecting contraptions, hunting lost treasure.

faq.q: Why does Kalaran need thorium plated daggers?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade can break down the daggers’ alloy and reforge it into a shaft to help hold the flawless flame.
Dark Iron slavers and taskmasters in the cauldron wield weapons of enchanted thorium.

faq.q: Where does this step fit into the chain?
aliases: what quest comes before forging the shaft
faq.answer: It follows The Flawless Flame, when you gathered materials for the torch of flawless flame.
Kalaran asks you to bring eight thorium plated daggers.
